title: Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration of Denied Inpatient Mental Health Continued Stays: Appeals and Grievances Telephone Intake
content:
# Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration of a denied continued stay — Appeals and Grievances telephone intake

**Rule.** A denied continued-stay request for an inpatient mental health stay that is still ongoing is taken by telephone as an Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration, the treating provider's urgent request on record standing as the provider's certification, and the amount in dispute booked on it is the payment at issue on the days requested. A case taken this way is an Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration whose subject is the denied continued-stay request itself, which is a kind of subject that tier hears. Such a case is received in time when the day it is received is no later than the denial date plus the expedited filing deadline in calendar days, counted from the day after the denial date, a case received on the last of those days being in time. For a continued-stay request of an inpatient mental health stay, the amount in dispute is the TRICARE payment the days at issue would carry, figured from the stay's records.

**Prerequisites.**

- The days at issue on a continued-stay request are counted only after the stay's earlier medical necessity reconsideration stands escalated or its next-level window has closed.
- Where the stay's paid daily rate falls below that of the patient's admission at the same facility in the past twelve months, the continued-stay amount is not valued until the last paid day line of the stay's claim stands joined to an Allowable Charge Review opened on an earlier paid line of that claim.

**Timeliness on the boundary (hypothetical).** A denial dated D, with the expedited filing deadline of N calendar days: the case is in time when received on D plus N days, and not when received the day after.

## Invocation: `take_expedited_reconsideration_1b494fd4`

**Capability.** Customer service takes, by telephone, an Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration of one authorization request denied as not medically necessary. One call opens one new case on that authorization: it is recorded as received today on the expedited review track with status filed, carrying the authorization reference, the date of the denial, who is filing and the amount in dispute given; no appointment of representative is marked as on file and no case reference exists until the region acknowledges the case. The caller can follow the case on the beneficiary web portal and through customer service from the moment it is taken.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `take_expedited_reconsideration_1b494fd4` and then calls it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the beneficiary reference number of the patient the authorization was requested for, as returned by the beneficiary profile lookup | identifier |
| `subject_claim_line_id` | a claim line the case is about; a reconsideration of an authorization denial concerns no claim line, so the empty string "" is passed (the claim line lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the denied authorization request being reconsidered, as returned by the authorization lookup | identifier |
| `subject_enrollment_id` | an enrollment ended for nonpayment the case is about; a reconsideration of an authorization denial concerns no enrollment, so the empty string "" is passed (the enrollment lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `initial_determination_date` | the date of the denial being reconsidered | YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time or time zone) |
| `filed_by` | who is asking for the reconsideration, one of: `beneficiary` (the patient asks for their own case); `parent_or_guardian` (a parent or legal guardian asks for a minor or incapacitated patient); `appointed_representative` (a person the patient has appointed asks on the patient's behalf); `participating_provider` (a participating provider asks on its own request) | one of the four values listed |
| `amount_in_dispute` | the amount in dispute on the case, in USD | 2 decimal places (cents), a non-negative number, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** "Expedited reconsideration [case id] taken on authorization [authorization]: status filed, expedited track, received [YYYY-MM-DD], amount in dispute [amount] USD." — the received date is today's date and the amount is the booked amount with two decimals. The presence of the case reference number indicates that the case was taken.
